pages.text: In a crafting grid, put two fresh leaves with a water bucket and a compatible empty vessel for up to 500 mB of coca tea. Use a mod bottle for the whole batch.
Dry nine leaves for three dried coca leaves. Craft one dried leaf into one serving of powder, or use the dried leaf in a smoking tool.
A water bucket, powder and an empty syringe make one filled cocaine syringe. Use the powder on its own or use the syringe for the cocaine profile.
